title: Vito's Only half Heart Challange
description:
This plugin starts every player with only half a heart.
If you die, the challenge is over
body: # 💖 Vitos Half Heart Challenge ![Screenshot of the Vitos Half Heart Challenge inside Minecraft](https://i.imgur.com/qHe0IZG.png) > 🎮 A lightweight Minecraft challenge Paper plugin where every hit matters. --- ## ✨ About the Plugin A simple Minecraft challenge plugin inspired by [BastiGHG](https://www.youtube.com/@BastiGHG). Only half a heart. One life. ## Perfect for: ```txt 🔥 Hardcore challenges 🎥 YouTube challenge videos 🎮 Multiplayer events ⚔️ Survival gameplay ``` --- ## 🚀 Features ```txt ❤️ Players only have half a heart 💀 Dying ends the challenge ⚡ Lightweight & optimized 🧩 Paper support 🎮 Easy to use commands 🔥 Perfect for challenge content ``` --- ## 📦 Commands ```txt ▶️ /challenge start → Start the challenge ⏸️ /challenge stop → Stop the challenge ▶️ /challenge resume → Resume the challenge 🔄 /challenge reset → Reset everything 🚩 /challange language → Switch language to De or to En ``` --- ## 🎯 Challenge Idea ```txt Can you beat Minecraft with only half a heart? ``` --- # 👤 Author [Discord Profile](https://discord.com/users/1470794991306805383) [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/VitooEU)
